from pathlib import Path
import os

path = Path('main.go')
tmp = path.with_suffix('.go.tmp')
content = '''package main

import (
	\"math/rand\"
	\"os\"
	\"text/template\"
)

func main() {
	tmpl := template.Must(template.New(\"greeting\").Parse(\"Hello World {{.}}\\\\n\"))

}
'''

    f.flush()
    os.fsync(f.fileno())
os.replace(tmp, path)
PY
